subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: Should statusless structured `invalid_request_error` responses receive the same cross-model fallback behavior as existing status-backed HTTP 400/422 request errors?
rationale: The implementation is correct and restores classifier parity, but it intentionally causes some user-, tool-, or configuration-generated request failures to try another provider or model instead of terminating on the primary. citeturn491077search0turn328197view0

options.title: Accept status parity
options.body: Approve the existing patch so structured statusless invalid requests follow the established 400/422 `format` fallback path.

options.title: Narrow the predicate
options.body: Require a narrower documented subtype or message predicate if generic request-validation failures should remain terminal.

recommendation.title: Accept status parity
recommendation.body: Approve the existing patch so structured statusless invalid requests follow the established 400/422 `format` fallback path.
